title: Inference Latency-Aware Tsetlin Machine Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.35304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Tsetlin Machine (TM) is a logic-based machine learning model well suited to low-latency inference on resource-constrained edge devices. Because each clause is an AND over Boolean literals, both the literals and their associated Tsetlin Automaton (TA) actions can be represented at the bit level, enabling bitwise evaluation and an early exit that is triggered as soon as any included literal evaluates to zero, forcing the clause output to zero. In this work, we study how the two TM training hyperparameters, T and s, govern both classification accuracy and inference latency. Building on the inversely proportional T-s relationship along which accuracy is nearly constant, we find that inference latency is reduced primarily by increasing s; rather than exhaustively searching the (T, s) grid at high training cost, we propose a directed search strategy that treats accuracy as a constraint and advances toward larger s to reduce inference laten

translated_title: 推理延迟感知的Tsetlin机器训练
translated_abstract: Tsetlin机器（TM）是一种基于逻辑的机器学习模型，非常适合在资源受限的边缘设备上进行低延迟推理。由于每个子句是布尔文字上的AND运算，文字及其相关的Tsetlin自动机（TA）动作都可以在位级别表示，从而支持按位求值和早期退出机制——一旦任何被包含的文字求值为零便立即触发，迫使子句输出为零。在本工作中，我们研究了TM的两个训练超参数T和s如何同时影响分类精度和推理延迟。基于T与s成反比且精度沿该关系几乎保持恒定的规律，我们发现推理延迟主要通过增大s来降低；为避免在高训练成本下对(T, s)网格进行穷举搜索，我们提出了一种定向搜索策略，该策略将精度作为约束条件，并向更大的s推进以降低推理延迟。
tldr: 提出了一种面向推理延迟的Tsetlin机器训练超参数定向搜索策略，在将精度作为约束的前提下通过增大参数s来降低边缘设备上的推理延迟，避免了高成本的(T, s)网格穷举搜索。
en_tdlr: Proposes a directed hyperparameter search strategy for Tsetlin Machine training that reduces inference latency by increasing s while treating accuracy as a constraint, avoiding costly exhaustive (T, s) grid searches.
